scope: Planar circular centerline with circular tube radius, hemispherical tube tips, optional larger spherical end guards. Equal pair in perpendicular planes. Not an extruded rectangular section, CAD-qualified product, force simulation, or all-path proof.

candidates.description: C with round enlarged end guards, gap20um
candidates.wear_scope: end-guard radial wear while guard diameter remains at least strand diameter

tolerance_boxes.note: Gap and diameter tolerance box. Uniform G1/G2 link body and end diameters; G3 keeps body no larger than the end guard. Not an empirical distribution or all-path proof.
